name: iter_round1_probe
description: ROUND-1 VISIBILITY PROBE: why does the loop's iteration 1 not show the companion paper's single-round whole-area win (~-0.25) at the same operating point? Candidate: the retraining budget. The companion protocol used early stopping, which keeps each retrain short; the loop retrains a fixed 400 epochs, long enough for both arms to converge on their 100 points and wash the placement advantage out. Crosses iters_retrain {100, 400} x early_stopping {on, off} at the static mix, K=8, 15 seeds; read the iteration-1 gap.
